lessons.advice: When embedding a condition in CASE WHEN, handle the empty-SQL representation of a match-all WHERE condition explicitly. Test backend-specific boolean rendering and preserve the distinction from a condition that matches nothing.

assumptions.statement: WhereNode.as_sql returns an empty SQL string with an empty parameter list when empty_needed reaches zero and the node is negated.
The original When.as_sql places compiler.compile(self.condition) output directly into the condition template parameter without an empty-string fallback.

scope.inputs: A condition successfully compiles to SQL and parameters
